dsh-tool-imagegen is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. OpenAI-compatible image generation for DSH Desktop: the model calls generate_image in chat and the images render inline in the conversation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-b4c1d81dd4d1f93346b4.html
